pre_merge_control_head_rule: Pin the exact final durable control head immediately before merge creation; its first-parent ancestry must contain eco_source_head_sha and its source delta must contain allowed control records only.
candidate_parent_rule: Candidate has exactly two parents: exact pre-merge control head first and exact main_base_sha second; candidate tree equals the immediate first-parent tree.
freshness_rule: Any change to main_base_sha or eco_source_head_sha before merge creation, synthetic PC0, evidence, exact-head review, draft PR or human merge requires stop, manifest refresh and repeated review.
